item.title: Pumpkin Spiced Cookies with Cream Cheese Glaze - Maha's Lovely Home
item.description: These are chewy pumpkin-spiced cookies with a cream cheese glaze and a salty pumpkin seed topping. The most important step for this recipe is blotting the pumpkin purée; getting the excess moisture out is what keeps the cookies chewy instead of cakey.

item.title: Fennel Sugar Cookies with Dark Chocolate - Maha's Lovely Home
item.description: The main flavor in these cookies comes from toasting whole fennel seeds and grinding them directly into the rolling sugar. This gives an otherwise simple, soft sugar cookie a grassy, anise-like flavor that works well against the bittersweet dark chocolate stuffed in the center. You can make them without the chocolate, but the stuffing helps balance the sweet fennel sugar.

item.title: Double Hazelnut Chocolate Chunk Cookies - Maha's Lovely Home
item.description: These cookies get hazelnut flavor from two directions: crunchy, caramelized hazelnut praline pieces mixed into the dough and a rich swirl of chocolate-hazelnut spread. This combination adds a ton of texture to an otherwise classic chocolate chunk cookie, which is finished with flaky salt to cut the sweetness of the praline.

item.title: Homemade Taco Bell Chipotle Sauce - Maha's Lovely Home
item.description: This is my version of the creamy chipotle sauce from Taco Bell. It's a simple mayonnaise and sour cream base that gets its smoky flavor from canned chipotle peppers. I use it on quesadillas, tacos, and burgers.

item.title: Greek Yogurt Ranch - Maha's Lovely Home
item.description: This is a quick ranch recipe that uses a Greek yogurt base instead of the traditional buttermilk and sour cream. A small amount of mayonnaise and some pickle brine help round it out and give it that classic ranch tang. It's a solid dip for vegetables or wings as-is, or you can thin it out to use as a salad dressing.

item.title: Spiced Carrot and Lentil Soup - Maha's Lovely Home
item.description: This is a smooth, velvety soup made from carrots and red lentils, which give it a great body without a lot of dairy. It's built on a base of browned butter and warm spices and served with crispy homemade za'atar pita chips.

item.title: Minnesota Wild Rice Soup - Maha's Lovely Home
item.description: This is my take on the classic Minnesota wild rice soup. It's a simple, humble soup with a creamy, roux-thickened base, but the star is the wild rice itself, which gives the soup a nutty, chewy texture. I add grated carrot and onion for the base and finish it with slivered almonds for crunch.

item.title: Creamy Gnocchi Soup - Maha's Lovely Home
item.description: This is a fast, one-pot meal using store-bought gnocchi that simmer directly in the herb-flecked broth. This method saves a step and the gnocchi's starch naturally thickens the soup, which gets a sharp, tangy note from a small amount of Dijon mustard.
